mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, board, symbol, title, content, price_at_write, fx_at_write, show_holding_badge, holding_qty_at_write, trade_tx_id, trade_side, trade_symbol, trade_price, trade_at, trade_pnl_krw, trade_pnl_rate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{board}, #{symbol}, #{title}, #{content}, #{priceAtWrite}, #{fxAtWrite}, #{showHoldingBadge}, #{holdingQtyAtWrite}, #{tradeTxId}, #{tradeSide}, #{tradeSymbol}, #{tradePrice}, #{tradeAt}, #{tradePnlKrw}, #{tradePnlRate})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE board = #{board} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.symbol = #{symbol} AND p.board = 'STOCK' AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND board = 'STOCK' AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET status = #{status}, deleted_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELETED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE deleted_at END WHERE id = #{postId}
UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
UPDATE posts SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
